scenarios.scenario: Show and hides a ribbon panel

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open and active
the expanded 3D Model ribbon shows the Modify panel
the Parameters panel is hidden
the user clicks the direct panel selector
Parameters is unchecked
Modify is checked
the user selects Parameters in the panel list
the Parameters panel appears in the ribbon
the panel list remains open with Parameters checked
the user selects Parameters again
the Parameters panel disappears from the ribbon
the panel list remains open with Parameters unchecked
the part remains active

scenarios.scenario: Hide and restore a View ribbon panel

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open and active
the View ribbon is expanded with Visibility, Appearance, Windows and Navigate visible
the user opens the View ribbon context menu and expand Show Panels
Visibility, Appearance, Windows and Navigate are checked
the user selects Navigate in Show Panels
the Navigate panel disappears from the View ribbon
the user switches to 3D Model and returns to View
the Navigate panel remains hidden
the user reopens Show Panels on the View ribbon
Navigate is unchecked
the user selects Navigate in Show Panels
the Navigate panel reappears on the View ribbon

scenarios.scenario: Hide a panel while the ribbon shows compact group buttons

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open and active
the 3D Model ribbon shows compact group buttons
the Parameters group button is visible
the user opens the compact ribbon context menu and expand Show Panels
Parameters is checked
the user selects Parameters in Show Panels
the Parameters group button disappears
the other compact group buttons remain visible and close the gap
the user returns the ribbon to its expanded display
the Parameters panel is absent from the expanded ribbon

scenarios.scenario: Hide and restore a panel on the side-docked ribbon

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open and active
the 3D Model ribbon is docked on the left
the Modify group is visible
the user opens the direct panel selector
Modify is checked
the user selects Modify in the panel selector
the Modify group disappears from the side-docked ribbon
the remaining ribbon groups reflow vertically
the panel selector remains open with Modify unchecked
the user selects Modify in the panel selector
the Modify group returns to the side-docked ribbon
the panel selector remains open with Modify checked

scenarios.scenario: Keep a panel hidden when redocking the floating ribbon

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open and active
the floating 3D Model ribbon shows the Modify group
the user hides Modify through Show Panels
the floating ribbon no longer shows the Modify group
the user docks the ribbon at the top
the top ribbon does not show the Modify panel
the user opens Show Panels on the top ribbon
Modify is unchecked
the user selects Modify
the Modify panel is visible again

scenarios.scenario: Hide and restore a panel while its expansion is pinned

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open and active
the expanded 3D Model ribbon is docked at the top
the Modify panel is visible with its additional commands expanded and pinned
the user opens the ribbon panel selector
the user clears Modify in the panel list
the Modify panel and its expanded command area disappear
the panel list remains open with Modify unchecked
the user selects Modify in the panel list
the Modify panel returns to the ribbon
its additional command area is not open
the panel list remains open with Modify checked
the user presses Escape
the panel list closes
the user opens the Modify additional command area
the user clicks empty viewport space
the additional command area closes

scenarios.scenario: Switch ribbon tabs while the direct panel list is open

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open and active
the expanded 3D Model ribbon is docked at the top
Modify is visible and Parameters is hidden
the user opens the ribbon panel selector
the panel list shows Modify checked and Parameters unchecked
the user selects the View ribbon tab
the panel list closes
the View ribbon is displayed
the user returns to the 3D Model ribbon tab
the panel list remains closed
Modify remains visible and Parameters remains hidden

scenarios.scenario: Dismiss the panel selector and expansion with Escape

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open and active
the 3D Model ribbon is docked on the left with the Modify panel visible
the Modify additional command area is open
the user opens the direct panel selector
the panel list opens with Modify checked
the Modify additional command area remains visible
the user presses Escape
the panel list closes
the Modify additional command area closes
the Modify panel remains visible

scenarios.scenario: Toggle the direct panel list without changing a checkbox

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open and active
the 3D Model ribbon is docked on the left with the Modify panel visible
the user clicks the direct panel selector arrow
the panel list opens with Modify checked
the user clicks the direct panel selector arrow again
the panel list closes
the Modify panel remains visible

scenarios.scenario: Inspect panel visibility from a minimized ribbon tab

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open and active
the top-docked ribbon is minimized to tabs with 3D Model active
the Modify panel is visible and Parameters is hidden
the user right-clicks the 3D Model tab
the ribbon context menu opens
the user opens Show Panels
the submenu lists the 3D Model panels
Modify is checked and Parameters is unchecked
the ribbon remains minimized to tabs
the user clicks an empty area of the viewport
both menus close
the ribbon remains minimized to tabs

scenarios.scenario: Enable a panel while the ribbon is minimized

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open and active
the top-docked ribbon is minimized to tabs with 3D Model active
the Parameters panel is hidden
the user right-clicks the 3D Model tab
the user opens Show Panels
the user selects the unchecked Parameters entry
the menus close and the ribbon remains minimized to tabs
the user clicks the 3D Model tab once
the temporary command area opens
it contains the Parameters panel
the user double-clicks the 3D Model tab
the full ribbon is restored
the Parameters panel is visible
